title.narrative: NIR ESG Materiality Assessment for ZCCM IH
NIR ESG Materiality Assessment for ZCCM IH

description.narrative:
1. To conduct a corporate Environmental and Social Due Diligence (ESDD) on ZCCMIH which culminates in an Environmental & Social Management/Action Plan setting out clear gaps in best practice and interventions to address these.
2. To conduct a capacity gap analysis of ZCCMIH and use this to develop a Capacity Building Plan which they can then use to seek either internal or external resources to address. This will improve the environmental and social performance of their mine holdings and also reduce the risks and negative impacts of the mining operations under their control.
3. To conduct an Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) Materiality Assessment which ZCCMIH can use as part of their corporate reporting, again giving investors more confidence in their awareness of risks and ability to manage those.

Sida shall contribute to ''The Baseline Assessment, Environmental and Social (E&S) Management System Analysis and Environmental and Social Governance (ESG) Materiality Assessment for ZCCM Investments Holdings Plc'' during October, 2025 to May, 2026.
